name: Unidentified escape craft
description: An escape craft was attached to Polan GX-8, a Polan-717 Jedi transport used by the Jedi Order. The escape craft was not equipped with a hyperdrive. Above the planet Brendok, Mae-ho Aniseya stole the escape craft and used it to flee from Jedi Master Sol aboard the Polan. Aniseya flew the vessel into the rings of a moon of Brendok, with Sol pursuing her. Although the escape craft was damaged in the pursuit, Aniseya exited the moon's rings and crash-landed on Brendok.
